$schema_note: Machine-readable availability/capability matrix for the Banzami Developers Sandbox/Preview documentation. Single conservative source checked by tests and mirrored by the PT/EN docs credential matrices. States: available_controlled_sandbox | documented_preview | pending_e2e | simulated | not_public | not_available | not_approved. This file describes the CURRENT Sandbox/Preview scope only — it is not a Production contract and makes no production/live/external-provider availability claim.

console_auth_workspaces_projects_members.note: Sign-in (email + OTP), workspaces, projects, members/roles/invites, test keys (reveal-once, rotate, revoke).

console_visual_pages.note: The Webhooks and Activity pages read the project’s own real data through developer-api. The dashboard is still a demo preview with illustrative data and is labelled as such on the page itself. Per-HTTP-request API logging is not recorded by the operator and is not shown anywhere.

developer_api_key.note: bz_test_ keys, direct Bearer; bz_live_ rejected fail-closed; no Production key issuance.

payment_sessions.note: Requires payment_sessions scope + ACTIVE project binding (or a merchant credential).

payment_links.note: Requires payment_links scope + ACTIVE project binding (or a merchant credential).

webhook_configuration.note: POST/GET /v1/webhooks/* with the webhooks:write and webhooks:read scopes. The signing secret is returned exactly once, on creation; another project’s endpoint answers 404.

webhook_outbound_delivery.note: Signed delivery verified on the deployed Sandbox against a public HTTPS receiver: signature confirmed independently over the raw bytes, tamper rejection, retry on 5xx and failure isolation. Sandbox only — no Production delivery claim.

refunds.note: POST /v1/refunds with the refunds:write scope. The refund debits the account that received the payment; a read-only key is refused (403) and another project’s payment answers 404.

transfers.note: POST /v1/wallet-account-transfers with the transfers:write scope. Moves value between two accounts of the caller’s own bound owner; an account outside that owner answers 404 as either endpoint.

wallet_accounts.note: POST /v1/wallet-accounts (wallet_accounts:create) and GET /v1/wallet-accounts, /{id} (wallet_accounts:read): segregated accounts inside the bound owner's wallet. PRIMARY is not creatable; another owner's account answers 404. Served on the deployed Sandbox; no released assurance capability records it on its own yet.

application_settlements.note: POST /v1/application-settlements with the application_settlements:write scope settles a segregated account's whole available balance to a beneficiary @banza at the price Banzami assigned (the request carries no amount or rate). GET /v1/application-settlements/{id} is merchant-credential only — a project key receives 401. Served on the deployed Sandbox; no released assurance capability records it yet.

production_live_rails.note: Production in preparation. No real money. No production key issuance.

pay_checkout_live_rails.note: Public pay/checkout surfaces are not available and not approved for restore.

external_provider_rails.note: No external provider is activated; activation is a separate governance decision.
